numbers.name: events_below_inspiral_bound
numbers.value: 2 (GW230712_090405: f = 0.0112 vs L = 0.0116; GW200308_173609: f = -0.048 from medians of separately reported masses)

note: PASS under Test Card T028 (approved 9725e1e1d before the run). In 225 of 227 nearly non-spinning binary black-hole mergers of the GWTC list the radiated mass fraction lies between the inspiral loss to the Schwarzschild ISCO, 0.0572 eta, and the Hawking area-theorem cap; none exceeds the cap. The median radiated fraction is 3.13 times the inspiral loss, so D8's lower bound covers about a third of the loss; merger and ringdown, which D8 leaves out, carry the rest. Weak test: typical fractions were known before drafting (SEEN_SUMMARY), and the catalogue final masses come from GR numerical-relativity fits, so this confirms that D8's composition brackets the GR answer, not an independent measurement. Not UET-distinct. L2 approved by the author on 2026-11-23. The run output (per-event f, L and U) was committed in 7473e3007 and removed from the tree afterwards, as for earlier cards; rerunning the script regenerates it.
